summary.text: Bryan Smith is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates representing District 73, which covers Marion and Taylor counties.
His committee assignments are Agriculture, Commerce, and Tourism, Government Administration, and Government Organization.

paragraphs.text: Smith was born in Grafton, West Virginia, on June 20, 1974, and graduated from Grafton High School in 1993.
His page lists a computer technician program in Fairmont in 1995, and his occupation as administrative assistant and business owner.
His affiliations include the Grafton Rotary Club, the Grafton Lions Club, All Aboard Grafton, the Mountaineer Trail Network, the Tygart Lake State Park Foundation and the National Rifle Association.
He is a board member of Save The Tygart Watershed.
